srList.sentence: The inclusion criteria were as follows: (1) healthy women aged 12-18 years who attended for HPV vaccine either bivalent (Cervarix, GlaxoSmithKline Biologicals, London, UK) or quadrivalent (Gardasil, Merck, Darmstadt, Germany) vaccine at public expense, (2) women aged 20-21 who already had HPV vaccination and visited clinichospitals for routine cancer screening, (3) unvaccinated women aged 20-21 who attended for cancer screening.
